observation.visible_scene: A static ground shot of rubble, broken concrete, gravel, dirt and scattered litter (a red-and-white wrapper, a green cap, a red cylindrical object, a pale rectangular brick). A thin wispy haze drifts in the upper-right area throughout the early frames.
visible_changes: For the first ~0.6 s the debris on the ground is motionless; only a faint haze drifts in the upper right (an already ongoing condition, not its onset).
At t≈0.63–0.67 s a bright orange-white flame flashes up near the lower-center debris and briefly expands to fill the center-right of the frame.
The flame then collapses almost immediately into a dense white smoke cloud that spreads across the center and right, billowing and drifting while partially occluding the rubble beneath.

The white smoke persists and continues to expand/drift through the end of the excerpt; the underlying litter and stones remain in their positions (e.g. the red-white wrapper and pale brick stay on the ground).
outside_clip_unknowns: The cause or trigger of the ignition and the identity of the object producing the smoke are not visible within the segment.
The state of the scene after the smoke clears is beyond the excerpt.
uncertain_details: Landmarks such as the green cap and pale brick appear to shift slightly downward/leftward between the early and later frames, hinting at minor camera movement, but this is partly obscured by the smoke and not firmly established.
A small red object is visible at the top edge only in later frames; whether it entered view via framing change or was always present is unclear.
